request: Fix the typo "recieve" in the README.

Add a --json flag to the status command that prints the same fields as JSON.

Let admins impersonate a user for support.

Delete the deprecated `export` subcommand and its tests.
Rewrite docs/guide.md so it explains how to install and set up the project.
Run factory-full: rename the `config` module to `settings`.
